resources.string: Review the game name and cover before saving. The ZIP includes configuration only, without the game or saves. Sharing does not require Discord.

In Containers, choose Export Community Config to edit the game name and cover. After saving the ZIP, choose Publish to community or share it with any app. New uploads start without verification; the maintainer can review them.
Configuration published. It appears in the community catalog without a verification badge until the maintainer reviews it.
